## Title / Summary
Short, descriptive title and a 1-2 sentence summary.

## Business Value / User Outcome
Why this matters to the user, product, or MVP.

## Scope
What is included. Optionally note what is intentionally out of scope.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...

## Dependencies and Assumptions
Any blockers, prerequisites, or assumptions.

## Security / Privacy / Data Considerations
Note only if relevant.

## Architecture / Design Considerations
Any relevant workflow, domain, or integration context.

## Testing Expectations
How the outcome should be validated.

## Documentation Expectations
Any user-facing, product, engineering, or operational docs needed.

## Definition of Ready Checks
- [ ] Business value is clear
- [ ] Scope is bounded
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are testable
- [ ] Dependencies/assumptions are captured
- [ ] Security/data is considered if relevant
- [ ] Design/architecture is noted if relevant
- [ ] Test approach is defined
- [ ] Documentation needs are identified
